findings: No active Meta ads under your name - five Hyderabad installers (Evergrid, Solox, Truzon, Punarvi, Twilight) are live this month buying the same homeowner with the same Rs. 78,000-subsidy message.

Incorporated in December 2012 and now a public limited company (CIN U40106TG2012PLC084777), TGREDCO-empanelled (TSRE180043) and a registered PM Surya Ghar vendor for Telangana North - 13+ years of rooftop and water-pump work, HQ in Kukatpally.

next_steps: The floating button's wa.me target is undefined in the served HTML. That is a lost-lead path on the channel your customers actually use.
Make the key content (what you do, where you operate, how to enquire) visible without JavaScript, so search and paid traffic see it instantly.

A small Meta budget on one residential offer, Kukatpally/Kompally/Secunderabad targeting, would put 13 years of rooftop work in front of buyers who currently only see competitor ads.
Telugu is the language of the Telangana homeowner - and it is what your competitors' creatives already speak.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
